title: 第369章 苦难的岁月成为追求的时刻
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“而且，最重要的是，这些人如果到了这里以后，未必就会痛恨是太子在白登山杀掉了她们的亲人。”

李禾眼里带着一种古怪的笑意。

审平眉头皱了起来：“就像是关中现在的情况一样，当初皇帝率军破武关，战蓝田，兵锋直接进入关中以后，关中父老扫榻相迎，人人都迎接沛公入关。

那个时候，还是沛公的皇帝与关中父老约法三章，这才稳定住了关中。

实际上，可以说秦国就是灭亡在了陛下手中的。

但是，关中人对陛下的痛恨，远远比不上项羽。”

审平的一番话，听得李禾连接点头：“不仅如此，这些妇孺们，本来就谈不上什么眼光的问题，她们的眼睛能看到，是谁人抢夺了她们的帐篷和牛羊，是谁人杀了她们的孩子。

同样也只能看到，是谁给了她们一口吃的。

是谁让她们活了下去！”

“所以！”

李禾看着刘盈笑道：“殿下完全不用担心这样的问题，更况且，我大汉军卒，需要在安澜城待着好几年的时间，如果这些军卒可以让这些失去了孩子的匈奴女人重新有一个孩子的话。

那，到时候就算是大军回撤的时候，把这些女人丢在这里不闻不问，她们也不会有什么怨恨的地方。

她们依旧会留在这片草原上，把孩子养大，然后教授孩子怎么牧羊，怎么把草原上该有的生活过下去。”

刘盈嘘嘘不已：“这事情听起来就像是王八蛋做的，可是这边经历了无数苦难的人，在老子看来是王八蛋才做的事情，对于这些人来说，竟然都是非常有盼头的生活。”

“你打算怎么规划安澜城外的房舍？”

刘盈自己想到了另外一种更加牛逼的建筑材料——水泥！

一点也不夸张的说，刘盈自己就会制作水泥。

这虽然和他以前上学时候的专业没有多大的关系，但是架不住他以前生活的那个时代，是短视频漫天飞舞的时代。

自然看到过一些人是怎么制作水泥的，巧的是他自己有一段时间闲着没事做的时候，就曾经看过许多自媒体主播们，是怎么制作那些奇奇怪怪的东西。

"And, most importantly, if these people get here, they may not hate the prince for killing their relatives on Baishan Mountain."

Li He had a strange smile in his eyes.

Shen Ping frowned: "Just like the current situation in Guanzhong, when the emperor led his army to break through Wuguan and fight against Lantian, after the soldiers entered Guanzhong directly, the elders of Guanzhong rushed to greet him, and everyone welcomed Pei Gong into Guanzhong.

At that time, the emperor who was still Peigong made a three-part agreement with the elders of Guanzhong, and then Guanzhong was stabilized.

In fact, it can be said that the State of Qin perished in the hands of His Majesty.

However, the people in Guanzhong hate His Majesty far less than Xiang Yu."

Shen Ping's words made Li He nod his head: "Not only that, these women and children have no problem with their vision. Their eyes can see who robbed their tents, cattle and sheep, and who killed their children.

You can also only see who gave them a bite to eat.

Who allowed them to live!"

"So!"

Li He looked at Liu Ying and smiled and said: "Your Highness does not need to worry about such a problem at all. What's more, my Han soldiers will need to stay in Anlan City for several years. If these soldiers can give these Hun women who have lost their children a new child.

Then, even if the army retreats and these women are left here and ignored, they will not have any resentment.

They will still stay on this grassland, raise their children, and then teach them how to shepherd sheep and live a life as they should on the grassland."

Liu Ying hissed: "This thing sounds like it was done by a bastard, but the people here who have experienced countless hardships, in my opinion, are things that only bastards do. For these people, they all have a very promising life."

"How do you plan to build a house outside Anlan City?"

Liu Ying herself thought of another more awesome building material - cement!

It is no exaggeration to say that Liu Ying can make cement herself.

Although this has nothing to do with his previous major in school, it cannot stand up to the era he lived in before, an era where short videos were flying all over the sky.

Naturally, he had seen how some people made cement. Coincidentally, when he had been idle for a while, he had seen how many self-media anchors made those strange things.
